                        <script type="text/javascript">
                            $(document).ready(function () {
                                var keywordInput = $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_txtKeyword");
                                if (keywordInput.length) {
                                    var btnClose = keywordInput.parent().find("#btnClosep_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_phCloseButton");
                                    if (btnClose.length) {
                                        //register an event handler that shows/hides the close button

                                            if (this.value === "") {

                                        });

                                            btnClose.hide();

                                            //trigger keyup in case the auto-suggest is showing
                                            keywordInput.trigger("keyup");
                                        });

                                        //also display the close button if there any current

                    <script type="text/javascript">
                        $(document).ready(function () {
                            var $textbox = $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_txtKeyword");
                            var $previewPanel = $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_pnlPreview");
                            var $keyword = "";
                            var getReq = "";
                            var $nodeLinksURL = $previewPanel.data("nodelinksurl");
                            var linkedNodesList = [];

                            // Load NodeIDs which have a non-null NodeLinkedNodeID
                            getReq = $.ajax({
                                url: $nodeLinksURL,
                                success: function (linkedNodes) {

                                    linkedNodesList = jQuery.parseJSON(linkedNodes);

                                }
                            });

                            $previewPanel.hide();

                            if ($previewPanel.length > 0) {
                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                    $keyword = $textbox.val();

                                    if ($keyword.length > 2) {
                                        setTimeout(function () {
                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                                    
                                                    var list = jQuery.parseJSON(data);
                                                    
                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {
                                                        if (parseInt(list[0].TotalNumberOfResults, 10) > parseInt($pageSize, 10)) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='more-results'><a id='MoreResultsLink' href>View all " + list[0].TotalNumberOfResults + " results</a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }
                                                    else {
                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                                    }

                                                    $("#MoreResultsLink").on("click", function (e) {
                                                        e.preventDefault();
                                                        $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_btnSearch").click();
                                                    })
                                                }
                                            })
                                        }, 250);
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        //hide the panel just in case it is visible
                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request
                                    if (xhr && xhr.readyState != 4) {
                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                $textbox.focus(function () {
                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                $textbox.focusout(function () {
                                    //slight timeout just so any preview-item clicks
                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });
                    </script>

                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();

                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                                    
                                                    var list = jQuery.parseJSON(data);
                                                    
                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();

                                                }

                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request

                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });

                            var $keyword = "";

                            var $nodeLinksURL = $previewPanel.data("nodelinksurl");
                            var linkedNodesList = [];

                            // Load NodeIDs which have a non-null NodeLinkedNodeID

                                url: $nodeLinksURL,
                                success: function (linkedNodes) {

                                    linkedNodesList = jQuery.parseJSON(linkedNodes);

                            if ($previewPanel.length > 0) {
                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");

                            if ($previewPanel.length > 0) {
                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");

                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                                }

                                        }, 250);

                            var $textbox = $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_txtKeyword");

                            var $keyword = "";
                            var getReq = "";
                            var $nodeLinksURL = $previewPanel.data("nodelinksurl");
                            var linkedNodesList = [];

                            // Load NodeIDs which have a non-null NodeLinkedNodeID
                            getReq = $.ajax({
                                url: $nodeLinksURL,
                                success: function (linkedNodes) {

                                    linkedNodesList = jQuery.parseJSON(linkedNodes);

                                }
                            });

                            $previewPanel.hide();

                            if ($previewPanel.length > 0) {
                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                    $keyword = $textbox.val();

                                    if ($keyword.length > 2) {
                                        setTimeout(function () {
                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();

                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {
                                                        if (parseInt(list[0].TotalNumberOfResults, 10) > parseInt($pageSize, 10)) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='more-results'><a id='MoreResultsLink' href>View all " + list[0].TotalNumberOfResults + " results</a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }
                                                    else {
                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                                    }

                                                    $("#MoreResultsLink").on("click", function (e) {
                                                        e.preventDefault();
                                                        $("#p_lt_ctl00_SearchKeywordFilterWithLivePreview2_btnSearch").click();
                                                    })
                                                }
                                            })
                                        }, 250);
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        //hide the panel just in case it is visible
                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request
                                    if (xhr && xhr.readyState != 4) {
                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                $textbox.focus(function () {
                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                    //slight timeout just so any preview-item clicks
                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });

                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();

                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                                    
                                                    var list = jQuery.parseJSON(data);
                                                    
                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();

                                                }

                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request

                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });

                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();

                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                                    
                                                    var list = jQuery.parseJSON(data);
                                                    
                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();

                                                }

                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request

                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });

                                var $url = $previewPanel.data("url");
                                var $luceneFilters = $previewPanel.data("lucenefilters");
                                var $pageSize = $previewPanel.data("pagesize");
                                var $truncateLength = $previewPanel.data("truncate");
                                var $searchIndex = $previewPanel.data("index");
                                var $typesNewTab = $previewPanel.data("typesnewtab");
                                var xhr = "";

                                $textbox.on("keyup", function () {
                                    $previewPanel.empty();

                                            xhr = $.ajax({
                                                url: $url,
                                                data: {
                                                    "keyword": $keyword,
                                                    "lucenefilters": $luceneFilters,
                                                    "pageSize": $pageSize,
                                                    "currentPageNumber": 1,
                                                    "contentTruncationLength": $truncateLength,
                                                    "searchIndex": $searchIndex
                                                },
                                                success: function (data) {
                                                    $previewPanel.empty();
                                                    
                                                    var list = jQuery.parseJSON(data);
                                                    
                                                    // Add list of items to search preview list
                                                    $.each(list, function (key, value) {

                                                        // Grab NodeID from value.Id
                                                        var nodeid = value.Id.substring(
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf(';') + 1,
                                                            value.Id.lastIndexOf('_')
                                                        );

                                                        // Only add item to preview if not in list filled at start of $(document).ready
                                                        if (!linkedNodesList.includes(parseInt(nodeid))) {
                                                            $previewPanel.append("<div class='preview-item'><div class='preview-icon'><span class='" + value.Type.replace(".", "-") + "'></span></div><div class='preview-details'><h3 class='preview-title'>" + value.Title + "</h3>" + (value.Content !== "" ? "<p class='preview-content'>" + value.Content + "</p>" : "") + "</div><a" + ($typesNewTab.includes(value.Type) ? " target='_blank'" : "") + " href='" + value.Url + "'></a></div>");
                                                        }

                                                    });

                                                    if (list.length > 0) {

                                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                                    }

                                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();

                                                }

                                        $previewPanel.hide();
                                    }

                                    //kill the request

                                        xhr.abort();
                                    }
                                });

                                    if ($previewPanel.find(".preview-item").length > 1) {
                                        $previewPanel.slideDown();
                                    }
                                });

                                    //low in the list have time to do their thing
                                    setTimeout(function () {
                                        $previewPanel.slideUp();
                                    }, 100);
                                })
                            }
                        });
